samples.note: Not D8b. _zbus_init assumes each channel's observations are contiguous in the zbus_channel_observation section, which upstream's linker script guarantees by sorting every iterable section by name. Patch 0004 gives that ordering up, so a channel's range is computed wrong and an observer is called through a garbage pointer, which V8 reports with the same message as a signature mismatch. A port bug: iterable-section ordering.
